overview_description.description:
Creditas is a financial technology company that operates a digital platform that offers secured consumer loans. It uses credit scoring systems and borrowers’ assets, such as homes and automobiles as collateral to offer loans. 

Sergio Furio founded BankFacil in 2012 that later became Creditas. It has its headquarters in São Paulo in Brazil.

about_short_description.short_description: Creditas is a consumer loaning startup that operates a digital platform providing secured loans and low interest rates.

identifier.value: Empréstimo com garantia de veículo (Vehicle-Backed Loan)

product.name: Empréstimo com garantia de veículo (Vehicle-Backed Loan)
product.description: A secured loan using a vehicle as collateral, offering credit from R$5,000 to R$150,000 with interest rates starting at 1.49% per month and repayment terms up to 60 months.

identifier.value: Empréstimo com garantia de imóvel (Real Estate-Backed Loan)

product.name: Empréstimo com garantia de imóvel (Real Estate-Backed Loan)
product.description: A secured loan using real estate property as collateral, offering credit up to R$3 million with interest rates starting at 1.09% per month plus IPCA and repayment terms up to 240 months.

product.name: Empréstimo consignado privado (Private Payroll-Deductible Loan)
product.description: A loan secured by the borrower's salary with fixed installments up to 35% of salary, offering credit from R$300 to R$70,000 and repayment terms up to 60 months.

product.name: Seguro Auto (Auto Insurance)
product.description: An online auto insurance service offering coverage options from up to 16 insurers, with digital contracting and payment in up to 10 installments without interest.

identifier.value: Financiamento imobiliário multibanco (Multibank Real Estate Financing)

product.name: Financiamento imobiliário multibanco (Multibank Real Estate Financing)
product.description: A real estate financing service that allows customers to simulate and compare offers from up to 8 banks, financing up to 90% of the property value with repayment terms up to 35 years.

identifier.value: Financiamento de veículo particular (Private Vehicle Financing)

product.name: Financiamento de veículo particular (Private Vehicle Financing)
product.description: A vehicle financing service that compares offers from up to 6 institutions, providing assistance with documentation and approval for private vehicle purchases.
